sources.title: Un Ministral, des Ministraux
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. October 16, 2024 launch identifies original Ministral 3B/8B and their commercial availability. Visually checked the base and instruct benchmark tables and plots: model names carry nominal sizes, but no active-parameter column or axis is present. The interleaved-attention claim is specifically for 8B; only 8B research weights are linked.

sources.title: Ministral 3B — exact legacy model reference
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved exact legacy Markdown October 27, 2026: ministral-3b-2410, 128k context, text input/output, release October 9, 2024 and December 2025 retirement. It explicitly links the replacement Ministral 3 3B as a different model. No total or active parameter field appears. The October 9 release remains in conflict with the contemporaneous October 16 public-availability announcement.

sources.title: API changelog — original Ministral release
sources.evidence: Retrospective 2024 October 9 entry explicitly says Ministral 3B (ministral-3b-2410) and 8B were released. This is release language, not merely a model creation timestamp, but conflicts with the contemporaneous October 16 public-availability announcement. No separate contemporaneous October 9 public availability evidence was located.

sources.title: Ministral 1 - 3B — model lifecycle
sources.evidence: Lifecycle table labels original model Ministral 1 - 3B, general-purpose base, with October 9, 2024 release. Delivered page contains lifecycle information; technical-documentation tab content was not accessible in that response. No parameter count or architecture is disclosed there. Lifecycle Active status does not establish current API availability.

sources.title: Ministral-3B — pinned Qualcomm model card before deprecation
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved pinned Qualcomm card October 27, 2026. It explicitly calls this an implementation of Ministral-3B, identifies the original commercial Ministraux and lists Number of parameters: 3B. Its purchase-only assets, licensing restrictions and 4096 compiled-device context distinguish this deployment documentation from open successor weights. No separate active count is listed.

sources.title: Ministral-3B implementation metadata v0.40.0
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved tagged official implementation metadata October 27, 2026. Names Mistral AI as model maker, original commercial Ministraux as the model and Number of parameters: 3B, with restricted model sharing and Contact For Purchase. Its parameter field supplies a nominal total; no active count is listed.

sources.title: Qualcomm and Mistral AI partner on original Ministral models
sources.evidence: October 23, 2024 announcement establishes the direct Mistral partnership for the newly launched commercial 3B and 8B on-device models. This corroborates the original-model identity of Qualcomm implementation documentation, independently of the later December 2025 Ministral 3 family.

sources.title: Original Ministral 8B Instruct model card — comparison check
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. Original Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 card includes original 3B base/instruct benchmark rows. Its dense Transformer and 36-layer architecture section is explicitly Ministral 8B; benchmark tables provide no active-parameter figure for 3B. Sibling specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Ministral 3 technical report — later-family check
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened full January 2026 report October 27. Sections 1 and 3.1 and Figure 1 explicitly derive the December 2025 Ministral 3 family through iterative pruning/distillation from Mistral Small 3.1, with vision encoders. Tables 1-5 describe that later family and its comparisons, not original ministral-3b-2410. This is no unchanged-architecture lineage connecting the original model to successor counts.

sources.title: Original upstream catalog identity
sources.evidence: Current raw source dates this undated catalog ID to October 16, 2024 and links the original ministraux announcement and Azure Ministral-3B. This identifies the frozen record as original Ministral 3B, not Ministral 3 3B Instruct 2512; catalog technical claims are independently checked rather than accepted as evidence.

sources.title: Qualcomm repository metadata
sources.evidence: Current public repository at fa81f551e98ae8eab8196b6bfda726c487bd4fc6 contains only .gitattributes and README, with zero stored weight bytes. Its current README is a deprecation notice. Public metadata availability does not establish public model weights; the pinned earlier card explicitly documents restricted assets.

sources.title: Phi-4-Mini technical report — original Ministral comparison check
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026. March 2025 report Tables 7 and 8 list Ministral 3B separately from Ministral-2410 8B and cite the 2024 Ministraux release. They report language/coding benchmark results and nominal sizes in model labels, with no active-parameter column or defined activated-count convention. No original-3B active count follows from these tables.

sources.title: Phi-4 Microsoft Research January 2025 brief — active-parameter plot check
sources.evidence: Reopened PDF October 27, 2026 and visually inspected page 1. MMLU-pro chart has an explicit Active Parameters (Billions) axis, but the Ministral point is Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410. No Ministral 3B point is present. Its useful 8B convention cannot establish the original 3B sibling count.

sources.title: Qwen3 technical report — later activated-parameter tables check
sources.evidence: Fresh full HTML checked October 27, 2026. The original Qwen3 research comparison tables explicitly report Activated Params for several comparison models, but contain no Ministral 3B entry. They provide no exact-model active-count evidence for ministral-3b-2410.

sources.title: TSVer — current original benchmark table and version check
sources.publisher: Marek Strong and Andreas Vlachos, University of Cambridge / ACL Anthology
sources.evidence: Read current complete PDF October 27, 2026. Search indexing surfaced an older Table 2 row for Ministral-3b-2410 at Params 3B; the retrieved PDF instead lists Ministral-3b-2512 at Params 3B in Table 2 (PDF page 8). Neither is an active-parameter column. The current successor row and stale indexed original row do not establish an activated count for the audited 2024 model.

name.note: Retain original model name. Exact legacy API identifier is ministral-3b-2410; this is not the newer Ministral 3 3B Instruct 2512 checkpoint.

developer.note: Mistral AI is the original developer; retain normalized catalog label.

family.note: Original Ministral family, introduced as les Ministraux. Its 2024 generation remains distinct from the replacement Ministral 3 family.

release_date.note: Retain the contemporaneous public launch date: the dated October 16 announcement says both models are available that day. Later exact-model docs, API changelog and legal lifecycle instead specify October 9. That earlier date is an unresolved primary-source conflict; no independent contemporaneous public availability evidence for October 9 was located. This value denotes the documented public launch, not a proven reconciliation of those records.

open_weights.note: Correct unsupported open-weights flag. Original 3B distribution requires a commercial agreement; only original 8B research weights were publicly released in the launch. Qualcomm explicitly restricts asset sharing and requires purchase; its public documentation repository contains no weights.

license.note: Exact original 3B row names Mistral Commercial License. Do not transfer the 8B research license or successor Apache 2.0 license.

parameters_b.note: Retain nominal 3B for original ministral-3b-2410. Mistral publishes the size in the model name; its direct implementation partner Qualcomm explicitly lists Number of parameters: 3B in the pinned original-model card and tagged metadata, freshly reopened October 27. A nominal specification does not require a tensor census. The December 2025 Ministral 3 family is a separately pruned/distilled lineage and supplies no count for this checkpoint.

active_parameters_b.note: Retain null after fresh October 27 searches for original Ministral 3B/ministral-3b-2410 plus active, activated, Active Params and later research comparisons. Original launch tables/figures, legacy docs and Qualcomm card/metadata do not report active parameters. Microsoft Phi-4-Mini Tables 7-8 provide benchmark scores only; its separate Phi-4 active-parameter chart includes the 8B sibling, not 3B. Qwen3 has no Ministral 3B row; current TSVer Table 2 uses the successor and an undifferentiated Params column. No named unchanged-architecture relationship supports borrowing the successor 3B active disclosure. Dense-equals-total catalog claims are not adopted.

architecture.note: Exact original 3B sources do not disclose dense versus MoE structure or an inspectable configuration. Launch interleaved attention and original 8B card architecture apply specifically to 8B; later dense Ministral 3 report describes another generation. Targeted original-model training and interpretability searches yielded no first-party architecture disclosure.

context_window.note: Developer specifies up to 128k. Preserve decimal catalog normalization 128000 as nominal capacity; an exact 128000 versus 131072 boundary is not established. Qualcomm 4096 is a compiled-device configuration and does not replace original model capacity.

modalities.note: Exact original API reference explicitly specifies text input and text output. Do not transfer vision support from its multimodal successor.

reasoning.note: Clear unsupported categorical false. Original launch discusses ordinary reasoning performance but does not explicitly classify a dedicated reasoning/thinking mode. No exact-original affirmative or negative mode statement was found; successor Instruct maintainer discussions do not establish original capability.

tool_call.note: Original launch describes function calling and exact dated model reference explicitly lists Function Calling.

description.value: Text model for on-device assistants and function-calling workflows, offered under a commercial license.
description.note: Use documented modalities, intended deployment, native tools and licensing; remove comparative efficiency claims.

patch.description: Text model for on-device assistants and function-calling workflows, offered under a commercial license.
patch.notes: Original October 2024 Ministral 3B (ministral-3b-2410), distinct from the December 2025 multimodal successor. Nominal 3B is supported by Mistral’s model name and Qualcomm’s explicit implementation specification; active parameters and internal architecture remain undisclosed. Weights require a commercial agreement. Public launch is October 16; retrospective developer records give October 9, an unresolved date conflict. Context is nominal 128k; dedicated reasoning mode is unverified. Legacy docs record December 2025 API retirement.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains original ministral-3b-2410 at a supported nominal 3B total and an undisclosed active count. Fresh original documents, visually inspected launch figures and later Microsoft/Qwen research comparisons provide no original-3B active specification. Successor counts are excluded by its separately documented pruning/distillation lineage. The other 12 field assessments and prior corrections are preserved; no weight shards or tensor census were used.
